title: CHAPO WHITE – Watermelon
description: CHAPO WHITE WATERMELON STRONG is an innovative tobacco-free nicotine pouch, offering a delightful sweet watermelon flavor. This product is designed for those who appreciate the taste of watermelon in a nicotine product. With 16.5mg of nicotine per gram, it caters to users looking for a strong yet sweet nicotine experience.
